leads.title: Aruba Criminal Code (Wetboek van Strafrecht; Kódigo Penal), enacted 2012, Articles 1:221, 2:61 and 2:62
leads.documents: Prohibition of unfair discrimination and incitement to hatred/violence including 'heterosexual or homosexual orientation'; definition of discrimination and penalties of fines to one year imprisonment.
